title: ActiveDPO: Active Direct Preference Optimization for Sample-Efficient Alignment

summary.claim: ActiveDPO picks which preference comparisons to send for human labeling with a theoretically grounded criterion that works for non-linear rewards, aligning better with fewer labels.
summary.condition: The LLM being aligned defines the reward model used for selection; several models and real preference datasets.
summary.gap: (Inferred) Focused on general alignment quality; which samples get selected for safety-related preferences is not studied.
